name: diffpilot
author: lklimek
description: Self-hosted web tool that helps a person review GitHub pull requests: final code with the changes grouped into flows and walked step by step, LLM analysis kept apart from deterministic facts, and project-level context. Also a work dashboard that ranks the user's pull requests, issues and MemCan TODOs, with an agent API and a feed of review comment decisions for agents to carry out.
access: Public, Apache-2.0. Self-hosted; there is no shared instance. Ask lklimek.
